instructions: Read AGENTS.md, docs/artifact-retention.md and docs/evidence/README.md. Preserve this project's existing evidence system. These rules authorize no deletion.

rules.name: generated-scratch
rules.instructions: Only reproducible task scratch, export staging and disposable test profiles belong here. Review ownership of every child and preserve staging needed by other tasks. Stop project jobs, preserve selected captures/logs in the existing evidence system, and review the guarded preview before authorized removal. Retained releases, imported MIDI, source and unique evidence must never be stored here.

rules.name: mixed-development-output
rules.instructions: Review exact children before proposing cleanup. Build contains dated audit, comparison and feedback evidence; exports mixes platform output with captures; dist contains versioned release records. Preserve useful originals and release provenance, maintain links from dated evidence records, and verify any archive copies. Use bounded Luna high/standard classification when available. Never clear these roots solely because they are ignored or rebuildable in part.
